purpose: Turn the Part I world from occasional ambient moments into a continuously inhabited low-cost runtime using baseline regional populations plus denser micro-events, while preserving the 30 FPS target and story topology.
runtime_rules: Maintain a baseline population around the player in addition to disposable micro-events.
Baseline actors are culled outside a broad radius and replenished gradually rather than spawned in one frame.
Danger state suppresses peaceful social/work events but does not freeze the entire world.
Moria remains civilian-empty; motion there comes from danger/aftermath and environment events.
Regional role mixes are deterministic enough for repeatable tests but varied enough to avoid clone crowds.
NPC tick throttling remains distance-based through AShireAmbientNPC.
No ambient actor owns story progress, save-critical state or quest coordinates.

implemented_now: existing social conversations, schedules and player awareness reused by new population
